Java Spring Boot / Microservices interview (3 YOE). Sharing some of the questions that were discussed.

3 min read
Just now

--

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by Christina @ wocintechchat.com M on UnsplashMany of them were scenario-based rather than theoretical:
🔹 Tell me about a recent feature you worked on end-to-end.
🔹 How do you participate in Agile ceremonies?
🔹 Explain your role from requirement gathering to production deployment.
🔹 What was your contribution in LLD (Low Level Design)?
🔹 How do you perform functional testing before handing over to QA?
🔹 How are downstream APIs integrated in your RTGS/payment flow?
🔹 How do you handle token generation and token refresh while calling secured APIs?
🔹 Do you generate a token for every API call? If not, how do you manage token expiry?
🔹 RestTemplate vs WebClient vs Feign Client.
🔹 What is the database layer in Spring Boot applications?
🔹 Why JPA? What are its advantages over JDBC?
🔹 If the database changes from MySQL/SQL Server to Oracle, what all changes would be required?
🔹 Will code changes also be required during DB migration?
🔹 Have you faced a scenario where APIs were working fine but response times suddenly increased?
🔹 How would you identify whether the issue is in the application, database, or downstream service?
🔹 If multiple API calls are causing latency, how would you optimize them?
🔹 Can asynchronous processing help? When should it not be used?
🔹 What if one API depends on another API’s response?
